02/22.12.2014
Mr. Deo, learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits that this appeal is directed against the
order dated 01.09.2014/02.09.2014 passed in F.S.S. Case No. 28 of 2013-14 whereby and
whereunder the appellant, having been found to have contravened the provisions as contained
under Sections 26 & 27 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, has been sentenced to pay fine of
Rs.3,00,000/-.

Being aggrieved with that order, this appeal has been preferred under Section 76 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 whereunder the appellant needs to deposit fee prescribed under the notification issued by the Central Government.
Since the appellant failed to get hold of the notification no fee could be paid.
Even stamp reporter could not point it out the amount which is required to be deposited.
In this situation, as per the appellant the appellant is at fix as to what amount is required to be deposited.
Further, it was submitted that the appeal is also barred by time by 33 days.
For condonation of which a limitation petition has been filed vide I.A. No. 6475 of 2014.

In this event, the appeal is not matured to be heard but the difficulty which the appellant would be facing is that the warrant of arrest issued would be executed against the appellant if the impugned order is not stayed.
Thus a great prejudice would be caused to appellant.

sentences.text: However, State is hereby directed to get hold of the said notification so that the amount which the appellant is liable to pay as fee be ascertained.

Meanwhile, the appellant by way of interim arrangement is directed to deposit a sum of Rs.
25,000/- by tomorrow i.e. 23.12.2014 by way of draft in the name of Registrar General, Jharkhand High Court, Ranchi.
Let this case be listed on 12.01.2015.

Till then, no coercive step shall be taken against the appellant- Manoj Verma @ Manoj Kumar Verma in connection with F.S.S. Case No.28 of 2013-14 pending in the court of learned Deputy Commissioner, Deoghar.
A copy of this order be handed over to the learned counsel appearing for both sides.
Let this order be communicated to the court concerned through FAX at the cost of the appellant, as prayed.
